snippet.title: OfMiceAndMechs – Publisher Announcement Teaser | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Meet OfMiceAndMechs, revealed during the GamingUp Showcase alongside the announcement that Ivy Juice Games will publish the game from developer MarxMustermann.

Fight, survive, subjugate and destroy. Build and fortify your base, establish production chains that turn raw scrap into finished steel and command your workers to keep everything running.

Your brain implant knows the way. The rest is up to you.

Wishlist OfMiceAndMechs now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4564040/OfMiceAndMechs/

#GamingUp #GamingUpShowcase #OfMiceAndMechs #IvyJuiceGames #IndieGames
